frames.note: Find gcd(1071, 462). Each step: divide a by b and keep the remainder
1071 = 2 × 462 + 147: any common divisor of 1071 and 462 also divides 147
Now gcd(462, 147): the old b and the remainder
462 = 3 × 147 + 21: any common divisor of 462 and 147 also divides 21
Now gcd(147, 21): the old b and the remainder
147 = 7 × 21 + 0: any common divisor of 147 and 21 also divides 0
The remainder is 0, so the last divisor, 21, is the gcd. 3 divisions
